name: Tether
author: Jordan Fulghum
description: iPhone messages in the Omarchy bar: an unread dot, your recent conversations, and inline replies, read live from Tether's daemon.

barWidget.description: iPhone conversations and replies, from the bar. Needs Tether (tetherd) paired with an iPhone.

schema.label: Hide the icon when the iPhone is not connected
Mark a conversation read when you open it
schema.description: Also marks it read on the iPhone, the same as Tether's own app. Turn off to leave the phone's unread state alone.

schema.label: Show message previews in the conversation list
schema.description: Turn off to show who wrote, but not what they said.
